name: Rotherham

outdoor.description: Picnic tables, outdoor exercise area and grass verge around the car park

notes: Opened 17 January 2025. Single junction site also reachable from the A630; separate HGV amenity building linked to the main building by an underpass. Waitrose is a Little Waitrose. Starbucks drive-thru too. Applegreen Electric 350kW and Tesla Superchargers.
uncertain: No Wikipedia article found; coordinates from motorwayservices.uk map page (SABRE/GeoHack link), consistent with M1 J33 at Whiston. No dog walking area mentioned.

name: Sawtry

outdoor.description: Children's play area, small verge at the back of the car park, public footpath connection

notes: Opened 31 March 2025. Designed for and signposted only to northbound traffic; southbound drivers can reach it via a roughly two-mile detour. BP forecourt. GRIDSERVE Electric Highway chargers.
uncertain: No Wikipedia article found; coordinates from motorwayservices.uk map page. No dog walking area mentioned.

name: Leeming Bar

outdoor.description: Picnic tables only, no grass area

notes: Officially a rest area, just over a mile from the junction, also reached from the A684. Minimal facilities: Costa, McDonald's drive-thru (leased), BP forecourt shop. Motel being demolished (announced Oct 2024). GRIDSERVE chargers.
uncertain: Opening hours not given; most facilities closed in 2020 and only Costa reopened, so it is very basic. Coordinates from motorwayservices.uk map page.

name: Todhills

outdoor.description: Small grass area at the back of the car park

notes: Officially a rest area on the former A74 stretch now part of the M6, north of Carlisle. Northbound is forecourt only (Shell, Select, Deli by Shell); its restaurant building has been closed since Moto left in 2023. Southbound has Costa (Moto), BP forecourt with Wild Bean Cafe and M&S Food, Travelodge, GRIDSERVE and Tesla chargers. No public link between sides.
uncertain: Map page gives two markers (54.950054,-2.9780942 and 54.9525,-2.9804116) without saying which side is which, so per-side coords left null and the midpoint used. EV chargers are southbound only (Shell plans northbound chargers in 2026). Small grass area side not stated.

name: Appleby Magna

outdoor.description: Grass verges and a picnic area at the back of the car park

notes: Small junction site (Shell 'Magna' forecourt with Select/Deli by Shell, plus McDonald's drive-thru), also reachable from the A444. InstaVolt chargers in the McDonald's car park. McDonald's car park has a 90-minute limit.
uncertain: No single site operator; opening hours not stated. Coordinates from motorwayservices.uk map page.

name: Ross Spur

outdoor.description: Grass verges only, with public footpath connections

notes: At the Traveller's Rest roundabout where the M50 ends, on the A449 near Ross-on-Wye. Esso forecourt (Asda Express since Feb 2024), Burger King and Starbucks drive-thrus. Current facilities are on the south-westbound side of the A449 but the site is reachable from both directions.
uncertain: No junction number stated. EV chargers not mentioned on motorwayservices.uk, so ev left null. Former north-eastbound side (outlet centre/KFC) status unknown. Coordinates from motorwayservices.uk map page.

name: Markham Vale (Chesterfield)

outdoor.description: Small grass verges, children's play area at the pub, public footpath connections

notes: Listed on motorwayservices.uk as Markham Vale, not Chesterfield. Cluster of drive-thrus and a Marston's pub plus Esso/Asda Express forecourt off J29A (A6192); not signposted in advance. EV Point, InstaVolt and Osprey chargers; GRIDSERVE hub under construction.
uncertain: Not an official signed motorway service area. Opening hours not stated. Coordinates from motorwayservices.uk map page.
